project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack application with real-time features
build_system: npm with Next.js CLI, Docker for production deployment
test_framework: Jest with React Testing Library for components, supertest-style integration tests for API routes
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install, 2. Run npm run build to verify compilation, 3. Run npm test for unit/integration tests, 4. Run docker build to verify containerization
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated from schema (npx prisma generate). Not checked in - generated at build time.
environment_constraints: Open internet - can install packages, pull Docker images, access external APIs. Node 22.23.1, npm 11.4.2, Docker 5.2.3 available.
contribution_requirements: User preferences: never push unverified code, error messages in UI not console, no silent failures, zero terminal interaction for user, API routes must have try/catch with error in response body, graceful degradation (AI scan fails -> manual entry).
key_patterns: Greenfield - establishing patterns: App Router with route groups for host/guest separation, SSE for real-time, Prisma for DB access, environment variables for secrets, Docker Compose for local dev with PostgreSQL.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes; src/lib/ - shared utilities (db, sse, ai); src/components/ - React components; prisma/ - database schema and migrations; public/ - static assets
